question: Panthi dance of Chhattisgarh is associated with followers of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guru Ghasidas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panthi dance** is a **folk dance** of **Chhattisgarh**, which is performed by the followers of **Guru Ghasidas.**
 
• It is closely associated with the **Satnami sect**, founded by **Guru Ghasidas**, who worked for the upliftment of the oppressed and preached against social injustice.
 
• The dance is performed to convey spiritual messages and to honor the teachings of **Guru Ghasidas**. Hence, it holds a **religious and cultural significance.**
 
• The Panthi dance is characterized by its **graceful movements**, which are synchronized with devotional songs, praising **Guru Ghasidas** and his principles of equality and truth.
 
• This dance is primarily performed during **religious occasions** and festivals related to the Satnami sect, such as **Guru Ghasidas Jayanti.**
 
• The dance not only serves as a spiritual expression but also helps in **preserving the traditions** and cultural identity of the Satnami community.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Guru Ghasidas.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Guru Ghasidas and the Satnami Sect:**

 
 
• **Guru Ghasidas** was a social reformer from Chhattisgarh who founded the **Satnami sect** in the early **19th century**.
 
• The Satnami sect emphasizes **truth, equality, and non-discrimination**. Guru Ghasidas preached against **caste-based discrimination** and worked for the upliftment of the marginalized sections of society.
 
• The teachings of Guru Ghasidas inspired his followers to adopt a life of **simplicity, devotion, and moral integrity.**
 
 
 
• **Characteristics of Panthi Dance:**
 
 
• Panthi dance is performed in a **group**, showcasing synchronized and rhythmic movements.
 
• It is accompanied by **traditional music** and devotional songs that glorify the teachings of Guru Ghasidas.
 
• The dance costumes are simple, reflecting the values of the Satnami sect, and performers often wear white attire as a symbol of **purity and equality.**
 
 
 
• **Significance of Panthi Dance:**
 
 
• The dance serves as a medium to **spread the message** of social harmony, truth, and equality.
 
• It is an integral part of the **cultural heritage** of Chhattisgarh and plays a vital role in preserving the Satnami traditions.
 
• Panthi dance is a **symbol of unity** among the Satnami community and promotes the teachings of their revered leader, Guru Ghasidas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Religious Influence:**

 
 
• **Guru Ghasidas Jayanti**, celebrated on **December 18**, is a major occasion for the performance of Panthi dance, highlighting its religious significance.
 
• The Satnami sect and Panthi dance are integral to the identity of the **Dalit and oppressed communities** in Chhattisgarh, reflecting their struggles and aspirations.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Folk Dances:**
 
 
• While Panthi dance is devotional, other folk dances of Chhattisgarh, such as **Sua Nacha** and **Raut Nacha**, are celebratory and focus on social gatherings.
 
• The **spiritual aspect** and strong connection with Guru Ghasidas set Panthi dance apart from other folk performances.
